title: Chapter 311 My Father Did It
content:
Chapter 311 My Father Did It

Boom!

The collision of swords and guns made the space in the bronze palace tremble.

The entire corridor began to tremble at this moment.

However, the strength between the two is obviously not on the same level.

After a stalemate for a moment, a figure was blown away.

And that figure is naturally Lu Xue.

There was a bang.

Lu Xue's figure hit the bronze wall, and then hit the ground heavily.

"Little Master!"

"Sister Xue!"

When Ao Qing and Xiao Luo and Qin Feng saw this scene, their eyes were suddenly filled with blood.

Xiao Luo and the others could only watch Chen Mingyu continue to walk towards Lu Xue.

Ao Qing forced himself to stand up slowly.

"If you want to kill the little master, you can pass my level first!"

Huh ~

A dragon breath blasted towards Chen Mingyu.

The scorching flames suddenly came to my face.

However, Chen Mingyu didn't even look at it, but just waved his gun casually, and a fierce gun intent was to blow the dragon breath away.

"The scoundrel shakes the tree, overestimates one's own abilities."

Cold words sounded from Chen Mingyu's mouth.

Hearing this, Lu Xue vomited blood, but was a little weak to refute.

For the first time, she clearly felt the hardships of the journey of cultivation.

No one will always be so smooth.

"Die."

Chen Mingyu walked to Lu Xue, staring at Lu Xue lying on the ground in front of him with cold eyes. The next moment, the spear in his hand suddenly stabbed out.

"Little Master!"

"Master, if you don't take action, you'll be burping!"

The last sentence was naturally the call in Ao Qing's heart. He believed that Lu Daosheng would definitely hear it.

laugh!

The silver spear ruthlessly stabbed into the bronze wall, but the scene of blood splattering did not appear.

"Um?"

Chen Mingyu frowned and said a slight suspicion.

I saw Lu Xue in front of me disappearing under my nose.

The next moment, he seemed to feel something and turned around and looked.

A cold wind came.

The entire corridor suddenly fell into a blind spot.

"Boss, what's going on?"

"I can't see it!"

The panic sound of the four people rang out from the corridor.

Huh ~

The wind is howling.

When a dazzling gun flashed, the entire corridor suddenly returned to peace.

In the corridor, the four of them stared blankly at the scene in front of them, and saw that Xiao Luoqinfeng, who was still in front of them, had already disappeared from the spot.

As for Lu Xue and Ao Qing, they were even missing.

Chen Mingyu looked ugly, and someone actually rescued the person he wanted to kill under his nose.

"Who is it?!"

The roar suddenly rang through the bronze palace.

"I know who it is."

At this time, Luo Qingshui spoke.

Suddenly, the four of them looked at Luo Qingshui.

And Luo Qingshui didn't keep it.

"The 22nd list of demons, Chu Lingsheng from Tiandi Academy."

"This Yin Feng is his work."

When everyone heard this, they immediately looked solemn.

This is indeed very consistent.

More importantly, Chu Lingsheng is also from Tiandi Academy, and it is reasonable to rescue Lu Xue and others.

"Boss, then do we still chase after you?"

The man with a fierce look looked at Chen Mingyu and asked.

Hearing this, Chen Mingyu took a deep breath and his murderous intent immediately suppressed him.

"Let's talk about it until you fully understand this bronze palace."

Compared to killing Lu Xue and others, what he cared more about was the mystery in the bronze palace.

You know, they had just entered the Bronze Palace, and he had a premonition that there must be a greater treasure deep in the Bronze Palace.

As for Lu Xue and others escaping from the ancient battlefield and becoming enemies with the Tiandi Academy.

Chen Mingyu didn't care.

This is a matter for the younger generation, so he doesn't believe it. Those old guys dare to take action against him regardless of their appearance.

What's more, he has grown up until now, as if no one is behind him.

Hearing Chen Mingyu's words, the others did not object, but just nodded slightly.

After a while, Chen Mingyu entered the state of enlightenment again.

Meanwhile, in a hidden cave far from the Bronze Palace.

Lu Xue leaned against the cave wall with a pale face. On one side was Ao Qing lying like a dead dog, and on the other side were Xiao Luo and Qin Feng who were still scared.

At this moment, they were all busy recovering from their injuries.

"You are so brave. Even Chen Mingyu dares to mess with him, but I don't dare."

Looking at Lu Xue and others, Chu Lingsheng couldn't help but sneer.

He naturally did it for the rescue of Lu Xue and others in the Bronze Palace.

Hearing this, Lu Xue slowly opened her big, watery eyes, but at this moment, her eyes were no longer as brilliance as before.

"My fault."

Lu Xue said calmly.

Hearing Lu Xue voluntarily admitting his mistake, Chu Lingsheng was slightly stunned, and the rest of his words to mock him had to swallow.

"I promised to protect you once, remember, we have cleared up this matter."

After saying that, Chu Lingsheng had no nonsense and was about to get up and leave.

He didn't forget that he also promised Lu Xue that he would have to give her what he had harvested in the ancient battlefield, so he had to continue exploring.

Now the ancient battlefield has undergone such a big change.

Maybe more good things will pop up.

Before we knew it, the people in the ancient battlefield had changed from the fear of facing the huge changes in the ancient battlefield at the beginning to the mentality of obtaining more treasures.

There are also fewer and fewer people who want to quit the ancient battlefield.

Because they found that the danger is much more dangerous, but the benefits are also many.

Just when Chu Lingsheng was about to leave, Ao Qing suddenly called him.

"Wait a moment."

Chu Lingsheng stopped.

"You have something to do?"

Looking at Ao Qing who was almost fine, Chu Lingsheng was slightly shocked.

It is worthy of being the Nine-Clawed Dragon, and that kind of injury has recovered in such a short time.

Although it is of great importance to healing pills, the speed is also extremely terrifying.

Lu Xue, who hadn't seen her, hadn't recovered yet.

"The biggest treasure in the entire ancient battlefield is in the Bronze Palace. Even if you go, you can only go to the Bronze Palace unless you choose to give up."

Ao Qing looked at Chu Lingsheng and said.

Hearing Ao Qing's words, Chu Lingsheng frowned slightly.

He knew that Ao Qing did not deceive him, and he had already felt it since he entered.

"You want me to fight Chen Mingyu with you."

Chu Lingsheng shook his head slightly.

"I can save you from him, it's just because he is not prepared. Although he doesn't want to admit it, I don't see enough in the face of him, so even if I add me, it's impossible to deal with him."

You know, Chen Mingyu is not alone.

"What if I break through?"

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly said.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo felt bitter in his heart.

Sister, you said that at the beginning, but in the end, I was almost burping and didn’t see any movement.

Of course, he only dared to complain about these words in his heart.

Lu Xue looked at Xiao Luo and his two faces, and her face couldn't help but flushed slightly.

"I'm serious this time."

Although she suffered a lot from Chen Mingyu, her realm began to loosen.

It’s not that there is a bottleneck, but that she needs an opportunity to break through. This opportunity is obviously not easy to break through with ordinary cultivation.

With her talent, this shouldn't be the case.

Lu Xue guessed that it was probably done by his own father.
